why: Plan round 1 and code round 1 both ended with verdict proceed; every finding was rejected with a reason, none was a defect in the code, so no fix commit and no second code round.

findings.summary: D6 can treat an unreadable quota bucket as proof the group is available
findings.reason: Plan frozen; code matches D6 (unreadable bucket skipped, undecided + Available parks nothing by design).

findings.summary: RoundEngine -> AfterRoundAsync wiring has no test
findings.reason: Plan frozen; already covered in code by ARoundThatFindsAQuotaSpentParksItForTheNextTests (a2b3fb55).

findings.summary: agy probe timeouts run sequentially in AfterRoundAsync
findings.reason: Plan frozen; code does what D5/D6 say, bounded by the launcher's 30 s per key.

findings.summary: D9 cooldown-line replaces the ledger reset-line on the card
findings.reason: Plan frozen: a plan change is out of scope here.

findings.summary: Quota keys cross the runtime boundary as untyped strings
findings.reason: Plan decision D3 (key is a string, also the persisted/wire key); typed key is a refactor beyond scope.

findings.summary: Test helper mutates its parsed JSON tree
findings.reason: Edits a fresh local parse of an immutable string and returns a new string; nothing shared is mutated.

findings.summary: A malformed Ok could lift a cooldown
findings.reason: Ok carries a NormalisedReview already accepted by the executor; a malformed answer is not Ok.

findings.summary: Gauge failure can erase an existing cooldown
findings.reason: Quiet() lifts only on an answered launch, else Nothing; a standing entry is untouched; extending would invent a date (S24).

findings.summary: Unreadable cooldown file silently reads as no cooldown
findings.reason: Fail-open by design (D4, S19, S37); write side refuses and notices (H1 fix).

findings.summary: Gauge probes run sequentially per spent key
findings.reason: Plan specifies one bounded probe per key; at most three agy groups are probed.

findings.summary: PanelService builds QuotaCooldowns instead of DI
findings.reason: PanelService is the composition root and builds the neighbouring stores the same way; other roads are a later plan (D12).

findings.summary: QuotaCooldowns drives the adapter's probe I/O
findings.reason: Plan decision D4/D5; refactor beyond scope.

findings.summary: AgyQuotaGroups is a static model table
findings.reason: D3 demands one explicit table, never a prefix; unknown family gets its own key.

findings.summary: Choice among refusals is inconsistent
findings.reason: refusals pre-filtered by Qualifies; the gauge is per key so the choice yields the same reading; no such inconsistency.

findings.summary: AgyError.Parse drops CRLF lines
findings.reason: TrimEntries trims the trailing CR; no failing input given.

findings.summary: AtomicFile.Write unexpected exception may leave a temp file
findings.reason: Existing helper used as D4 prescribes; not a case of this change.

findings.summary: Vendor message persisted verbatim
findings.reason: Already goes through VendorReason.Written (the product's one redactor) and the cap.

findings.summary: Uncached reads of quota-cooldowns.json per provider
findings.reason: D4: read on every CanRun, no cache, file under 16 KiB; cross-process writer.

findings.summary: Sequential agy probe execution stalls the round
findings.reason: Duplicate of the sequential-probe finding.

findings.summary: Time left 61 min shows 2 h
findings.reason: The plan requires rounding up (S31-S33).
